priceNote: Nebraska average for a nursing home (semi-private to private room). This facility does not publish its price.

inspections.title: Resident was abused or neglected
inspections.detail: Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.
inspections.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation

inspections.title: Resident choices not respected
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to and the facility must promote and facilitate resident self-determination through support of resident choice.

inspections.title: Suspected abuse or neglect not reported on time
inspections.detail: Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.
inspections.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Pressure sores not prevented or treated
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate pressure ulcer care and prevent new ulcers from developing.

inspections.title: Feeding tube care problems
inspections.detail: Ensure that feeding tubes are  not used unless there is a medical reason and the resident agrees; and provide appropriate care for a resident with a feeding tube.

inspections.title: Unnecessary medications given
inspections.detail: Ensure each resident’s drug regimen must be free from unnecessary drugs.

inspections.title: Food stored or prepared unsafely
inspections.detail: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.title: Care plan not updated on time
inspections.detail: Develop the complete care plan within 7 days of the comprehensive assessment; and prepared, reviewed, and revised by a team of health professionals.

inspections.title: Mobility / range-of-motion care not provided
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate care for a resident to maintain and/or improve range of motion (ROM), limited ROM and/or mobility, unless a decline is for a medical reason.

inspections.title: Incontinence or catheter care problems
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.

inspections.title: Not require residents to give up Medicare or Medicaid benefits, or pay privately as a condition of admission; and must tell residents what care they do not provide
inspections.detail: Not require residents to give up Medicare or Medicaid benefits, or pay privately as a condition of admission; and must tell residents what care they do not provide.

inspections.title: Unclean or uncomfortable living space
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.

inspections.title: Family or doctor not told about a change or injury
inspections.detail: Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.

quality.label: Needing more help with daily activities

openings.note: Estimate: certified beds minus average daily residents (CMS). Certified beds are often more than the beds actually staffed. Call to confirm.
